newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia says WTO is "win-win" for exporters.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia says WTO is "win-win" for exporters.

text.p: Australia said on Friday that agreements reached at the World Trade Organisation's inaugural ministerial meeting in Singapore represented a "win-win" outcome for Australian exporters.

A statement released by Trade Minister Tim Fischer, who has been at the Singapore meeting, said the WTO meeting agreed on a range of steps delivering "gains pure and simple" for Australian exporters and industry.
"It has delivered opportunities for Australian exporters which are both broad and deep," said Fischer, who is also deputy prime minister.

"Sectors from the fast-growing high-technology and services industries to our more traditional farm and food sectors will feel the benefits. And those benefits will start to flow from early next year and continue well into the new century," he added.
